name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Employment

requirements.blocker_text: A copy of the work permit form authorizing paid labour activity in Azerbaijan is required to obtain temporary residence on the employment ground.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a work permit for paid employment in Azerbaijan.

requirements.blocker_text: Highly qualified specialists qualify for temporary residence on a distinct ground from standard employment; specific qualifying criteria were not detailed on the source reviewed.

sources.title: Azerbaijan State Migration Service -- grounds for temporary residence permit including employment (work permit holders) and highly qualified specialists as a distinct category

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Azerbaijan). No separate self-employed/freelance (work_independent) residence route distinct from az_investor_residence.json's entrepreneurship/business-owner ground was found for Azerbaijan -- an independent professional would need to either secure sponsored employment (this file), register as a qualifying entrepreneur/business owner, or meet one of az_investor_residence.json's investment thresholds; disclosed as a genuine structural gap rather than an unresearched one. work_rights modeled 'restricted' since status is tied to the specific work permit/employer. citizenship_after_months (60) and pr_after_months (24) reuse the general figures from az_naturalisation.json and az_permanent_residence.json.
